chunks: And from him, from Safwan, from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the visitation of the House (Kaaba) during the Days of Tashriq, so he said, 'It is good (hasan).'

key_terms.أَيَّامَ التَّشْرِيقِ: Days of Tashriq (11th, 12th, 13th of Dhu al-Hijjah)
key_terms.حَسَنٌ: Good/Premissible (a technical term in Shia fiqh indicating a recommended or valid act)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to visit the Kaaba during the Days of Tashriq?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the flexibility in the Hajj ritual calendar, specifically regarding the post-Eid al-Adha period. By affirming the visitation as 'hasan' (good/preferable), Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the continuation of devotional acts during the Days of Tashriq, reinforcing the scholarly view that the Hajj rites extend beyond the immediate day of sacrifice. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the spiritual continuity of the pilgrimage experience.
